main_text.l: (Dum viveret) Medicinæ ac Philosophiæ Doctoris, hujusque primum Lovanii in prima Cathedra, post Lugd. apud Bat. Profess. eximii, dialecticorum maximi, veræ Virtutis ac novo-veteris sapientiæ instauratoris indefessi, inter Philosophos & Oratores hujus ævi facile primi,
omnibus suis partibus in lucem edita, & tam seculi hujus, quam atheorum quorundam Philosophorum impietati, scelestisque moribus, quanquam Speciofo utplurimum Virtutis pratextu larvatis, oppofita

page.notes: Woodcut flower ornament between the PHILARETHUM line and the imprint; handwritten or printer's marks ("p. Lau", "ʃbʏʒ") appear beside the name and are not transcribed. The first line's Greek is set in capitals; the marginal "Ν" and "ꝑ" are part of the printed title. Several words in the italic block are partly obscured by the printer's device and are uncertain.
